items.title: An inverse limit of finite sober spaces over a directed set is spectral
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the inverse limit of a directed inverse system of finite sober topological spaces is spectral (author lemma at source lines 4850-4854, label lemma-directed-inverse-limit-finite-sober-spectral-spaces). The proof (source lines 4856-4874) exhibits a basis of quasi-compact opens given by pullbacks, checks that intersections of basis opens are again basis opens and produces a generic point of any closed irreducible subset as the compatible family of the generic points of its images (proof lines 4856-4873). The quasi-compactness of the basis opens and the generic point construction are the substance. H3.
